reasoning: Integrating a photo gallery from a reference Eleventy project into an existing Eleventy site. This requires adding the @11ty/eleventy-img plugin for image optimization, creating enhanced gallery templates with lightbox functionality, and adapting the reference implementation. The existing site already has gallery infrastructure (paintings.json, gallery section), making this a well-scoped enhancement rather than a greenfield feature.

scope.notes: Files to modify: eleventy.config.js, index.njk (gallery section), styles.css, main.js, paintings.json/gallery data, possibly new gallery page template. Single frontend/static site service.

infrastructure.notes: Only eleventy.config.js changes needed to add image shortcode. No Docker, database, or deployment infrastructure changes required.

knowledge.notes: Existing Eleventy 3.x patterns in codebase. Has Nunjucks templates, passthrough copy setup, and gallery data structure. Research needed for eleventy-img shortcode syntax and lightbox/modal implementation.

Responsive image generation compatibility with Eleventy 3.x
